newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan may recruit opposition members as cabinet ministers
-- Taiwan authorities secretly ask banks to check fund flows of Formosa Plastics group
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Peru's elite commandos free 71 hostages in surprise attack
-- President Lee Teng-hui supports merge of Kaohsiung city and county
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwanese gunman suspected of killing Taoyuan county commissioner arrested in Manila
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan may adopt new criteria to ban Formosa Plastic's China power plant project
-- Ruling Nationalist Party may invest in constructing hotel and office buildings in vietnam
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui backs merge of Kaohsiung city and county
-- Taiwan, Hongkong to hold shipping talks on May 2
